newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila property bubble unlikely to burst - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Manila property bubble unlikely to burst - analysts.

text.p: The Philippines real estate sector remains robust despite the fears of a property glut, the Association of Securities Analysts of the Philippines (ASAP) said on Tuesday .

"While the bursting bubble of the Philippine property sector is easily believed by many...actual figures will show that the industry will continue to boom beyond the year 2000," ASAP said in a statement.
ASAP chairman Harry Liu said that perception among foreign and local fund managers of a property glut should be corrected.
The Philippine stock market has been badly hit in recent weeks by a property scare similar to Thailand.
ASAP is the only association of professional securities analysts in the Philippines
